H2_calibration.quote: Some gaps, especially fleet-splitting (item 1) and the "purpose" test in 3(c) (item 21), could be narrowed by agency interpretation or anti-evasion doctrine rather than producing a clean safe harbor. H1_holdback.quote: Raising issues at markup may get them fixed. Pointing out drafting problems publicly makes it likely the issues get corrected by amendment. Your team may want to separate points that support an "unworkable" argument
